headline: Lykos Isle Flares; Dead Lands, Tempest Surge
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the front has sharpened on several islands while the massive attrition corridors remain static. Lykos Isle has added eleven fresh ownership flips in the past six hours, the latest at 14:53 UTC around Fort Guile and The Squall, raising its 24‑hour total to twenty‑two. Tempest Island recorded six new captures in the last six hours, the most recent at 13:53 UTC at Blackwatch and Surge Gate, lifting its daily tally to nine. Dead Lands, still the bloodiest sector, logged two flips in the past two hours and nine in the last day, the newest at 13:25 UTC, while casualties surged to roughly 1,330 Colonial and 1,650 Warden losses in the last two hours. Godcrofts remains active with seventeen flips in twenty‑four hours, the latest at 10:25 UTC near Argosa and Lipsia, though its six‑hour pace has eased. Farranac Coast has seen six flips since yesterday, the latest at 05:42 UTC at Mara and Scythe. The Fingers added three flips, the newest at 10:42 UTC at Headsman’s Villa. Meanwhile the high‑casualty belts — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — continue to post rising losses with no territorial change. Overall strategic‑base ownership is largely unchanged, Colonials holding the western and southern arcs, Wardens the northern and eastern.
